Class ServicePointStats

java.lang.Object
simu.model.ServicePointStats
public class ServicePointStats extends Object
Represents the statistics collected for a service point.

    • ServicePointStats

      public ServicePointStats(String serviceName, double averageWaitingTime, int maxQueueLength, int currentCapacity, double totalServiceTime, int numberStarted, double utilization)
      Creates a ServicePointStats object with the specified statistics.
      Parameters:
      serviceName - the services name
      averageWaitingTime - the waiting time for the service
      maxQueueLength - the queue length for the service
      currentCapacity - the current capacity for the service
      totalServiceTime - total service time
      numberStarted - how many services were started
      utilization - the utilization of the service
